title: Navidrome desktop client acceptance
scope: Navidrome defines complete music-client functionality; MixRadio PC/WP defines components, layout, visual treatment and design only. Windows 8.1 Store desktop is the primary target.

scoreAnchors.1: A fragment works; the task cannot be completed.
scoreAnchors.2: The task completes with material defects.
scoreAnchors.3: Every stated criterion is met with reproducible evidence.
scoreAnchors.4: Criteria also hold across the specified alternate states, repeated runs, and measured limits.

cases.title: Installed PC package provenance
steps: Run inspect_reference.py against the installed PC directory.
Inspect its inventory and decoded XBF coverage.
expected: Identity is 2.2.0.7933 x86; input hashes are recorded.
98 XBF v1 trees decode; static evidence is labelled separately from runtime screenshots.

cases.title: Phone package provenance
steps: Run inspect_reference.py against the supplied XAP.
Inspect recovered XAML and application/audio decompilation.
expected: Identity is 4.5.3.470 and the input SHA-256 matches.
73 application XAML documents are recovered; phone patterns do not become desktop containers.

cases.title: Fresh desktop build
steps: Build Client.csproj Debug x86 with MSBuild 14.0.
Inspect the emitted manifest and appx.
expected: Build exits zero using the legacy 8.1 target.
Every new source/view/resource is included in the project; warnings are recorded.

cases.title: Fresh serializer regressions
steps: Run tools/serializer-tests/run.ps1.
Confirm it compiles the current production sources before running.
expected: Genre, radio, getSong, directory and playlist serialization assertions pass.
The runner does not inspect a stale prebuilt assembly.

cases.title: Selected context and append are distinct
steps: Start with another queue.
Click song C in an ordered A/B/C/D source; use Previous and Next.
Append one song with Add to queue.
expected: Context queue is A/B/C/D with index C; Previous reaches B.
Appending keeps existing order; invalid indices leave the queue intact.

cases.title: Queue mutation and clear
steps: Remove the active entry while playing.
Remove the last item and clear the queue.
expected: Active removal advances to a valid successor; the removed item stops.
Clear stops playback, clears current item, and invalidates stale shuffle history.

cases.title: Complete shuffle cycles
steps: Shuffle an 11-entry queue with repeat off.
Repeat complete cycles with repeat all.
Test empty and single-entry queues.
expected: Every entry, including the last, is played once per cycle.
No immediate repeat at a boundary when alternatives exist.
Off stops at cycle end; empty and single-entry cases stay valid.

cases.title: Off, all, one, and manual skip
steps: Cycle repeat through off/all/one/off.
Send natural media-end and manual Next separately.
Save and restore repeat and shuffle state.
expected: Off stops at the queue end; all wraps; one repeats the current entry.
Manual Next escapes repeat one.
Restoration keeps repeat mode separately from shuffle.

cases.title: Bounded recent-listening model
steps: Record more than 100 distinct listens.
Replay an existing entry and serialize/restore the model.
expected: At most 100 entries remain, newest first, without duplicate song IDs.
Metadata and artwork IDs round-trip; streaming URLs and passwords are absent.

cases.title: Star/unstar protocol
steps: Run protocol regressions with encoded IDs and successful/failed responses.
expected: star.view and unstar.view receive an encoded song ID.
Only status=ok confirms the change; failed responses keep the previous state.

cases.title: Desktop Hub visual comparison
steps: Capture matching app-content crops of original PC and client at 1366x768, 100% scale.
Compare sections, typography, spacing, accent, content and command hierarchy with compare.py.
Repeat with a playing item and an empty queue.
expected: Real Hub sections pan together with no fabricated minimum canvas.
Artwork, titles, progress and empty state represent live data.
Accent is #FFFF2E80; alignment and command density follow the PC reference.

cases.title: Large desktop visual comparison
steps: Compare the same states at 1920x1080 without scaling typography.
expected: Content fills the canvas naturally; no excessive blank scroll area.
Type roles, artwork and sections keep their intended sizes and alignment.

cases.title: 320px recomposition
steps: Resize client app content to 320x768.
Browse, search, play/pause, open queue and playback options.
Navigate back and restore the wide view.
expected: Readable vertical lists and a compact live player replace the expansion prompt.
Search and primary actions remain reachable; targets are at least 44 logical pixels.
No clipped commands, lost selection, or unintended playback reset.

cases.title: 500px recomposition
steps: Repeat narrow-view navigation at 500x768.
expected: The page is usable without maximizing.
Search, lists, playback options and queue remain operable.

cases.title: Portrait and height changes
steps: Resize to 768x1024 and then a short landscape window during playback.
expected: Content reflows without lost scroll/selection or duplicate playback.
Commands remain reachable through panning or scrolling.

cases.title: Discoverable typed search
steps: Use Ctrl+F, type a padded query, submit with Enter and then the search button.
Query matches artists, albums, songs, Unicode and a no-results term.
expected: Search is visible before panning; whitespace is trimmed.
Typed groups and real cover art appear; newer results win over slower earlier requests.
No-results and recoverable errors are distinct; Back returns to browsing.

cases.title: Browse the Navidrome library
steps: Use artists, albums, genres, playlists and favourites.
Open an album and a genre; play a selected song.
expected: Server-backed lists and titles appear; letter grouping is meaningful.
All song actions produce the intended context queue.

cases.title: Actual media and transport
steps: Play, pause, resume, previous, next and stop actual audio.
Observe the same track on the home page and queue.
expected: Art, title, artist, elapsed/duration and play/pause state are live.
Progress freezes during pause; transport controls change actual audio.
A failed media open does not appear as a successful listen.

cases.title: Recent listening survives restart
steps: Start three actual tracks, pause/resume, and cause a media-open failure.
Restart and replay a recent entry.
expected: Successful media starts appear newest first; resume does not duplicate an entry.
Failed opens add no history.
Restart restores history and replay fetches current stream/art data.

cases.title: Account isolation and persistence failure
steps: Use two local fixture accounts/libraries; change password without changing account.
Test missing/corrupt history and a failed write.
expected: Different server/account combinations have separate histories.
Password changes keep history; old-account results do not leak into the new account.
Write failure preserves the last committed file and shows a recoverable message.

cases.title: Confirmed favourites and rollback
steps: Star/unstar a fixture song through playback options, then reopen Favourites.
Reject a mutation at the fixture server; change tracks while a mutation is pending.
expected: Confirmed server state appears in Favourites.
Failed requests preserve the previous state and expose the error.
A pending operation updates its target song without toggling the newly playing song.

cases.title: Queue save/load and cancellation
steps: Save a two-entry queue through the picker, clear it and load it.
Cancel both pickers; load malformed content.
expected: Titles, IDs and order round-trip.
Displayed extension matches the real payload; cancellation preserves the queue.
Malformed input has a recoverable error and does not destroy a valid queue.

cases.title: Remote playlist management
steps: Create, rename, edit and delete an owned fixture playlist; reject one request.
expected: Server playlist state follows confirmed operations.
Failure retains state and remains recoverable.

cases.title: Configured internet stations
steps: Use a fixture station and an empty radio response.
expected: Configured stations play through transport controls.
Empty/unsupported station responses are honest and recoverable.

cases.title: Connection configuration
steps: Set primary/secondary URLs and a local fixture account, test, restart.
Test invalid credentials, unreachable server, and missing configuration.
expected: Connection settings persist and account identity remains consistent.
Errors do not produce blank grids or crash the app; retry is reachable.
Credentials do not appear in acceptance evidence.

cases.title: Loading, empty, error and offline
steps: Delay responses, return empty data, reject a request and disconnect.
Recover and retry while keeping a valid queue.
expected: Loading, empty and error are distinguishable.
Recovery is possible; failed responses do not fabricate content or destroy the queue.

cases.title: Back, mouse and transient UI
steps: Use Back, Alt+Left and mouse navigation after search/detail.
Open/close playback options and resize.
expected: Back closes transient UI or restores the prior page coherently.
No duplicate navigation, stuck flyout, or playback restart.

cases.title: Keyboard, focus and high DPI
steps: Complete browsing, search and playback with Tab/Enter/Space.
Repeat at 150% and 200% display scale with long metadata.
expected: Focus is visible; automation names match actions.
No hover-only primary controls, overlaps or unreadable text.
Logical touch targets remain at least 44px.

cases.title: Background playback
steps: Minimize during audio, use system transport and reactivate.
expected: Playback and current track remain coherent; pause/resume works.
History records the actual start once and the UI resynchronizes.

cases.title: English defaults and localized resources
steps: Inspect and build resources; switch to an unsupported OS language.
Review the current app's new visible copy and labels.
expected: Default English resources resolve through the default resource map.
New user-visible language is resource-backed.
No gigs/personalization promises or project acceptance requirements appear in the app.

cases.title: Audio scrubbing
steps: Seek within a supported stream and repeat near boundaries.
expected: Position changes actual audio and stays coherent after pause/resume.

cases.title: Local downloads and offline library
steps: Download a library item, restart offline, play, cancel and delete a download.
expected: Persistent download state, cancellation, quota/error handling and offline playback work.

cases.title: Library-based artist mixes
steps: Seed a mix from local artists with sufficient and sparse libraries.
expected: The mix uses documented local-library rules and does not imply proprietary recommendations.

cases.title: Locked Navidrome source and distinct reference authorities
steps: Run tools/navidrome/source.ps1 and inspect_source.py with the design inventory.
expected: The checkout equals the locked commit and has no local edits.
Both functional Navidrome source and design MixRadio inputs are hashed.

cases.title: Native protocol and model regressions
steps: Run tools/navidrome-tests/run.ps1 against current production sources.
expected: Encoded IDs/credentials, repeated parameters, milliseconds and failure responses behave correctly.
All new models deserialize actual Navidrome-shaped XML.

cases.title: Accessible server-library selection
steps: Use two accessible music folders and switch selection during a slow request.
expected: Album, artist, song, genre and search queries use the selected returned ID.
An older request or another account cannot replace the selected library state.

cases.title: Complete album lists and sort/filter choices
steps: Browse a library larger than one page; use every album list, genre and year range.
expected: No silent 500-album truncation; further pages and refresh are reachable.
Name, artist, newest, recent, frequent, random, starred, rating, genre and year results match server semantics.

cases.title: All songs and independent search pagination
steps: Browse more than one page of songs and search for matches spanning all three result types.
expected: Song, album and artist offsets advance independently.
The blank library query returns songs; stale requests do not corrupt current results.

cases.title: Server song/album/artist metadata
steps: Open tracks with multiple artists, disc/track, Unicode, missing dates and quality information.
expected: Metadata is read from responses with useful missing-value treatment.
Artist/album navigation resolves server IDs; no guessed identities.

cases.title: Favorites for songs, albums and artists
steps: Star and unstar all three entity types; reject one request and reload favorites.
expected: All three favorite collections are shown.
Confirmed results change the captured item; failure preserves existing state.

cases.title: Ratings from zero to five
steps: Set and clear song, album and artist ratings; simulate an authorization error.
expected: Zero clears a rating; only 0–5 are accepted.
Failed requests do not change the displayed rating.

cases.title: Server artist/album information and discovery
steps: Open artist/album information, top songs and similar songs with populated and empty metadata.
expected: Metadata uses Navidrome rather than obsolete EchoNest endpoints.
Similar artists navigate by returned ID; mixes use actual server similarity/top-song results.

cases.title: Structured and synchronized lyrics
steps: Load multiple lyric variants, timestamped lines, offsets and a song without lyrics; switch tracks during load.
expected: Variants retain their returned language and timing.
Current lines follow actual playback position; empty, unsupported and failure states are explicit.

cases.title: Server queue, order and position
steps: Play next, reorder, save a queue containing duplicate songs, then restore it and its position.
expected: Ordered entries are preserved without URL-length loss.
Negotiated indexBasedQueue retains the selected duplicate occurrence; milliseconds resume at the saved position.
Failed or stale loads preserve the current queue.

cases.title: Playlist content, metadata and permissions
steps: Create a playlist, add/remove/reorder songs, edit name/comment/public state and view another owner or smart playlist.
expected: Server state matches edits and duplicate ordering.
Read-only/foreign/smart playlists preserve server permission rules; rejected writes do not fake success.

cases.title: Actual playback reporting and scrobbles
steps: Play, pause, seek, skip, finish, fail a media open and repeat one track.
expected: Only actual playback is reported.
PlaybackReport is negotiated; compatible legacy scrobbling counts listening rather than seeked position.
Each real listen is accounted for once and account changes cannot report to the wrong user.

cases.title: Save and resume bookmarks
steps: Save a position/comment, list it, resume and delete; reject a save.
expected: Position is sent and restored in milliseconds.
Failed saves/deletes preserve current data.

cases.title: Server shares and disabled sharing
steps: Create/list/edit/delete a fixture share; repeat with sharing disabled.
expected: Use the returned URL and expiration; send only explicitly requested edits.
Server-disabled sharing displays a recoverable unavailable state.

cases.title: Playback preferences and stream quality
steps: Change volume/mute, speed, format and bitrate; restart and play a lossless file.
expected: Persisted preferences affect actual playback and stream requests.
Supported codecs are selectable; playback fallback handles actual media failure without false history.

cases.title: User permissions and scan state
steps: Read current user and scan status; compare administrator and regular user.
expected: Returned roles determine scan command availability.
Only an administrator can start a scan; no privileged endpoints are guessed.

cases.title: Negotiated optional and unsupported functions
steps: Compare current and older servers, absent lyric/index queue extensions and disabled shares.
expected: Extension versions come from the actual response.
Podcasts/video/deprecated endpoints are not presented as supported Navidrome functions.
Capability failure does not replace a working connection with invented metadata.
